Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

How often are new updates added on EduMint24?
We add new government job updates every day. This page always shows the 50 most recent posts across all categories - new vacancies, admit cards, results, and answer keys — so bookmark it and check daily.
What types of updates are listed on this page?
This page covers all types of sarkari updates 2026 - new vacancy notifications, admit card releases, exam results, and answer keys from SSC, Railway, UPSC, Banking, State PSC, and other recruitment boards.
How do I spot a newly added post?
Posts published within the last 3 days show a red New badge next to the title. You can spot them instantly when you scroll through the list.
Can I apply directly from this page?
No. Click the View button on any post to open its detail page. There you'll find the official apply online link, important dates, eligibility, and the full notification details.
How do I find updates for a specific category?
Use our Categories page to filter by SSC, Railway, Banking, Results, Admit Cards, and more. You can also use the Search to find any post by keyword.
